qs.en: I watch a television programme every evening.

qs.en: Scientists are studying the emission of pollutants into the atmosphere.

qs.en: The Monday morning programme always talks about politics and current events.

qs.s: Combien de ___ regardez-vous chaque semaine?
qs.en: How many programmes do you watch each week?

qs.en: I don't like this new programme on this channel.

qs.s: ___ du courrier est prévue entre 10h et 11h chaque jour ouvrable.
qs.en: The arrival of the mail is expected between 10 and 11 a.m. every working day.

qs.en: It's a new arrival on the market; we're waiting for the first customer feedback.

qs.en: Upon crossing the finish line, the runner was completely exhausted.

qs.en: We welcomed the arrival of the refugees with essential provisions.

qs.s: La ___ économique d'une nation détermine son influence internationale.
qs.en: The economic power of a nation determines its international influence.

qs.s: Les États-Unis sont une ___ mondiale.
qs.en: The United States is a world power.

qs.en: He displayed impressive power during the competition.

qs.s: Le moteur développe ___ de 200 chevaux-vapeur.

qs.en: In the West, the power of the media strongly influences public opinion.

qs.en: Technological progress has multiplied the power of our electronic devices.

qs.en: Military force and politics illustrate two forms of power.

qs.en: The great European powers faced each other for centuries.

qs.s: Les plus fortes ___ continentales se préparent au conflit.

qs.s: Elle travaille avec sa ___ sur ce projet.

qs.s: Les ___ de danse répètent ensemble chaque semaine.
qs.en: The dance partners practice together every week.

qs.s: Avez-vous parlé à ___ de cette opportunité?
qs.en: Did you speak to your partner about this opportunity?

qs.s: Nous avons signé un contrat avec nos ___.
qs.en: We signed a contract with our partners.

qs.s: C'est un excellent ___ de travail.
qs.en: He is an excellent work partner.

qs.s: Sa ___ lui a proposé une nouvelle stratégie.
qs.en: His (female) partner proposed a new strategy to him.

qs.s: Dans une relation amoureuse, un ___ est quelqu'un que vous aimez.
qs.en: In a romantic relationship, a partner is someone you love.

qs.en: In tennis, you need a partner to play doubles.

qs.s: Nos ___ commerciaux viennent de plusieurs pays.
qs.en: Our business partners come from several countries.

qs.s: Elle a trouvé ___ parfait pour danser le tango.
qs.en: She found the perfect partner to dance the tango.

qs.en: To succeed with this project, we must choose a reliable partner.

qs.s: Nous avons créé une alliance avec ___ de confiance.

qs.s: Ma mère ___ toujours de mon travail.
qs.en: My mother is always satisfied with my work.

qs.s: Tu ___ de ce résultat ? C'est excellent !
qs.en: Are you (m.) satisfied with this result? It's excellent!

qs.s: Nous ne ___ pas de cette offre d'emploi.

qs.s: Je ___ de mon achat récent.
qs.en: I (m.) am satisfied with my recent purchase.

qs.s: Elle ___ du résultat et a célébré sa victoire.
qs.en: She was satisfied with the result and celebrated her victory.

qs.s: Ils ___ de cette solution rapidement trouvée hier.
qs.en: They (m.) were satisfied with this quickly found solution yesterday.

qs.s: Autrefois, il ___ de son salaire modeste.
qs.en: Formerly, he was satisfied with his modest salary.

qs.s: Elles ___ toujours de notre travail ensemble.
qs.en: They (f.) were always satisfied with our work together.

qs.s: Elle ___ sans doute de cette proposition.

qs.s: Ils ___ probablement de cette compensation.
qs.en: They (m.) will probably be satisfied with this compensation.

qs.s: Il ___ de ce compromis en d'autres circonstances.
qs.en: He would be satisfied with this compromise in other circumstances.

qs.s: Elles ___ facilement d'une simple explication.

qs.s: Il est important qu'elle ___ du résultat.

qs.s: Je doute qu'ils ___ de cette explication.
qs.en: I doubt that they (m.) are satisfied with this explanation.

qs.s: Ce petit cadeau l'a ___ pendant toute la journée.
qs.en: This small gift satisfied him/her the entire day.

qs.s: Rien ne semble pouvoir ___ ses ambitions démesurées.
qs.en: Nothing seems able to satisfy his excessive ambitions.

qs.s: Le manager espère ___ tous les clients avec ce nouveau service.
qs.en: The manager hopes to satisfy all customers with this new service.

qs.s: Cette augmentation salariale n'a pas vraiment ___ les employés.
qs.en: This salary increase did not really satisfy the employees.

qs.s: Un simple repas aurait pu les ___ à cette époque.
qs.en: A simple meal could have satisfied them at that time.

qs.s: Elle s'___ de peu et ne se plaint jamais.
qs.en: She contents herself with little and never complains.

qs.s: Les enfants se ___ de jouer dans le jardin.
qs.en: The children are content playing in the garden.

qs.s: Il se ___ en silence sans réclamer davantage.
qs.en: He contented himself in silence without asking for more.
